title: Simple Changes Weight Loss Intervention
brief_summary: The investigators examined feasibility and acceptability of a non-restrictive diet focused on increasing dietary fiber and lean protein for weight loss. Fifteen obese adults enrolled in a 12-week assessment which included 6 bi-weekly individual dietary counseling sessions to attain a daily goal of higher fiber (\>35 g/day) and lean protein (0.8 g per kilogram/day of individual's ideal body weight).
